patches.value: For every t>0, e(·,t) is Lebesgue integrable. Also, there exist a finite closed interval J=[s₀,s₁]⊂(0,∞) with s₀<t<s₁ and a compact set C⊂ℝⁿ such that, for every s∈J and every x∉C, u(x,s)=q, ∂_s u(x,s)=0, and ∂_{x_j}u(x,s)=0 for each j=1,…,n. For every s∈J, the functions x↦u_t(x,s), x↦∂_{x_j}u(x,s), x↦e(x,s), and x↦e_t(x,s) are continuous on ℝⁿ and vanish for every x∉C, for each j=1,…,n.
